method: 396 synchronized GPU-finish/readback renders, Chromium SwiftShader software GPU, 960x640 DPR1. Colour campaign: 3 variants × 3 profiles × 3 world views × 12 warm alternating samples, local shadow disabled equally. Shadow campaign: original/new × 3 profiles × one ground forest view × 12 samples with their correct source-bound lighting; wind/time held, steady solar map, not forced-refresh latency. Exact paired full climate and camera asserted. All pages resident per campaign; allocation probe counts logical bytes, not physical VRAM. No concurrent graphics workload. Local startup values are individual observations, not Internet/mobile figures.
